name: dr0019-cu-sweep
description: DR-0019 C_u sensitivity sweep (issue #211). The adc-enob-fft deck's analyses / measure / checks blocks, copied byte-for-byte so every sweep point is point-for-point comparable with the ratified dynamic campaign, run against parametric variants of the SAME generated netlist at a swept CDAC unit capacitance. Each recorded run overrides the netlist below with `--netlist <variant>` + `--netlist-provenance 'schematic (...)'`; the variant decks are emitted by sim/dr0019-cu-sweep/gen_cu_variant.py, which asserts that the ratified C_u reproduces the deck named here byte-for-byte.
claim: CHARACTERIZATION, not a spec row. How the schematic-level SFDR and ENOB of the DR-0014 converter move as a function of the CDAC unit capacitance C_u, across the DR-0019 resize (17.24 fF -> 35.6528 fF) and beyond it -- the controlled isolation spec/testbench-suite-memo.md Sec 11.2 flags as undone and issue #211 asks for. No point here is a verdict on README.md's ENOB or SFDR rows: those rows are claimed by sim/adc-enob-fft/ at the RATIFIED C_u, and a sweep point at a non-ratified C_u is not a measurement of the ratified design. SFDR/ENOB themselves are spectral quantities, computed from these records' raw per-corner logs by sim/adc-enob-fft/testbench/analyze_fft.py and collated by sim/dr0019-cu-sweep/analyze_sweep.py.

code_max.description: COVERAGE WITNESS, upper end: a near-full-scale sine must actually drive the converter near full scale. Without it an FFT taken over a stuck or heavily attenuated output would still produce a plausible-looking spectrum. The window allows for the 0.94 amplitude backoff and the gain error the SUPERSEDED top-plate sampling phase measured, together; it does NOT allow a clipped capture, which would pin at 1023.5. Under DR-0014 the gain term is expected to cancel, so the window's lower edge is now slack rather than tight -- #61 owns closing it against a measurement.

code_min.description: COVERAGE WITNESS, lower end, same window.

vref_droop_mv.description: Peak-to-peak movement of the V_REF node across the capture, through DR-0002's ratified >= 40 nF / <= 240 ohm envelope. Same measurement sim/adc-inl-dnl/ carries, and for the same reason: it is this deck's corner-sensitivity assertion. The charge the array demands per conversion is set by the MiM sections and the switch R_on, so a sabotaged corner sweep (sim/harness/README.md mechanism 3) collapses its process-axis spread.

decerr_c000_lsb.description: Reported, not bounded. Worst |input-referred error| over the ten decisions of one conversion, measured inside that conversion's trial phases -- but for a NEAR-NYQUIST input it is dominated by the input's own motion through the trial window, because the ideal shadow path compares the held top plates against the instantaneous input. It is kept as a cross-corner consistency witness (the nine PVT points agree to ~1 %), not as a decision-error claim; the static decision-error claim is sim/adc-inl-dnl/'s decerr_t<k>_lsb, where the input IS static and the node means what it says.

notes: WHAT THIS RECORD IS AND IS NOT. This is a CHARACTERIZATION record from a parametric sweep: it reports what the converter does at ONE non-ratified (or ratified) value of C_u, to isolate a mechanism. The harness verdict below covers only the CAPTURE's validity -- the coverage witnesses that the sine actually drove the converter across its range without clipping, and the V_REF corner-sensitivity floor -- exactly as in sim/adc-enob-fft/. It is NOT a verdict on README.md's ENOB or SFDR rows, and a reader must not cite a sweep point as the design's performance: the ratified design is C_u = 35.6528 fF and its dynamic evidence is sim/adc-enob-fft/'s own records.

COHERENCE, stated rather than asserted: N = 64 samples capture exactly M = 31 whole input cycles, and gcd(31, 64) = 1 because 31 is prime, so the N samples land on N distinct input phases and the record contains an integer number of periods. The signal therefore occupies bin M exactly, with no boundary discontinuity to repair -- which is what makes window = none valid here.

The 9-point (3 process x 3 supply, all at 125 C) grid is inherited UNCHANGED from sim/adc-enob-fft/'s own records so each sweep point is point-for-point comparable with the pre- and post-resize captures issue #211 reports. Same two-stage corner strategy, same justification: spec/testbench-suite-memo.md Sec 5.
evidence.data_provenance: simulated -- ngspice transient of the schematic-level DR-0014 converter, one recorded run per sweep point, netlist emitted by sim/dr0019-cu-sweep/gen_cu_variant.py from design/adc-top/gen_adc_top.py with C_UNIT_FF rebound (and, for the orthogonal control point, the CDAC cell's fourth-leg T-gate width scaled).
